weakest_link: The staff-mount rests mainly on one bone object lying beside one piece (Gellep) and on the unringed pair being larger. No dodecahedron has been found actually fixed to a rod. The cosmological meaning is an add-on that explains none of the physical features.
flip_test: Microscopy or CT of the rims of the unringed pair against the ringed holes, across roughly 20 or more pieces, plus residue analysis for wood or bone. | If the unringed rims show no fitting abrasion, burnish or organic residue that the ringed holes lack, and no piece shows a socket or fixing trace, Idea 1 drops below Idea 2 or "none". If such marks do appear consistently, Idea 1 rises above about 60%.
unknown: Even if they were mounted on staffs, we still would not know what the object meant, who carried it or on what occasions, or why the tradition stayed in the north-west.
